items.exampleEn: The plan looked good at the time, but in retrospect, it was too dangerous.
items.exampleZh: 那個計畫當時看起來不錯，但回頭看，其實太危險了。

items.exampleEn: The ad was persuasive, so I bought the shoes.
items.exampleZh: 那則廣告很有說服力，所以我買了那雙鞋。

items.exampleEn: His silence was an acknowledgment that he was wrong.
items.exampleZh: 他的沉默等於承認自己錯了。

items.exampleEn: She wears the ring in remembrance of her happy school days.
items.exampleZh: 她戴著那枚戒指，紀念她快樂的學生時代。

items.exampleEn: The movie was riddled with funny mistakes.
items.exampleZh: 那部電影充滿了好笑的錯誤。

items.exampleEn: Brainstorming works best in small groups.
items.exampleZh: 腦力激盪在小組裡效果最好。

items.exampleEn: He has a lot of common sense, so people trust him.
items.exampleZh: 他很有常識，所以大家都信任他。

items.sentenceEn: We spent an hour brainstorming ideas for the party.
items.sentenceZh: 我們花了一個小時為派對腦力激盪。

items.audioEn: Use your common sense: don't leave your bag alone at the airport.
items.audioZh: 運用常識：在機場不要把包包放著不管。
options: Always keep your bag with you.
Keep your ticket in your bag.

items.sentenceEn: The old road was riddled with holes.
items.sentenceZh: 那條舊路上到處都是坑洞。

items.sentenceEn: The street was named in remembrance of a famous singer.
items.sentenceZh: 這條街以一位知名歌手命名，作為紀念。

items.stemEn: It's just ____ to wear a coat when it's snowing.
Her ____ speech made many people want to help the poor dogs.
items.stemZh: 她那場很有說服力的演講，讓很多人想幫助那些可憐的狗。

items.passageEn: Last year, our school turned one hundred years old. Our class wanted to make something in remembrance of the school's first day. We started with a brainstorming meeting. Our first plan was riddled with problems: it was too expensive and too big. Then Leo made a persuasive point: "Let's use common sense and make something simple." We decided to make a photo wall. Many of the old photos were precious to the older teachers. At the opening, the headteacher's speech included a warm acknowledgment of our hard work. In retrospect, it was one of the best moments of my school life.
items.passageZh: 去年，我們學校滿一百歲。我們班想做點什麼來紀念學校的第一天。我們先開了一次腦力激盪會議。我們的第一個計畫問題重重：太貴也太大了。接著 Leo 提出一個很有說服力的意見：「我們用常識想一想，做個簡單的東西吧。」我們決定做一面照片牆。許多老照片對年長的老師們來說都很珍貴。開幕時，校長在致詞中特別感謝了我們的努力。回想起來，那是我學生生活中最美好的時刻之一。

questions.questionZh: 第一個計畫有什麼問題？
options: 老師們都不同意這個計畫

questions.questionZh: 校長在致詞中做了什麼？
options: 感謝了全班同學的努力

items.promptZh: 回想起來，我應該早點出發。
referenceEn: In retrospect, I should have left earlier.
In retrospect, I should have set off earlier.
rubricZh: retrospect 表示「回顧、回想」，例如 in retrospect 等說法
時態配合內容（例如 should have + 過去分詞等）

items.promptZh: 這不需要專業知識，只需要一點常識。
referenceEn: You don't need special knowledge for this, just a little common sense.
This doesn't need expert knowledge; it only needs some common sense.
rubricZh: 用 common sense 表示「常識；判斷力」（不可數，例如 a little common sense）
